purpose: Section 12-15 remediation: the single, explicit governance registry for current Stage-3 scientific evidence. Every artifact referenced anywhere in the Stage-3 governance layer must have an explicit status here - governance is NEVER inferred from filename or key-name substrings (e.g. never 'skip if key contains historical'). ml/stage3_science_resolver.py is the only code path that should be used to resolve 'the current governing result' for a family; it reads this file and fails closed on any ambiguity.
rule: Within a family, exactly one artifact may have status GOVERNING. HISTORICAL, SUPERSEDED, INVALIDATED, NONCANONICAL_REPRODUCTION, and PENDING artifacts may never be treated as governing regardless of key name or position in this file.
